channel.title: Vibe Coding Wiki
channel.description: 178-term bilingual taxonomy for AI-assisted programming. Open source. Primary-source citations. Updates when terms are added or corrected.

item.title: Vibe Coding Wiki v2.2 Launch · 178 terms, 8 layers, 14 scenarios
item.description:
Major release: 178 terms across 8 layers (Paradigm → Methodology → Tech → Tools → Quality → Risk → Prompting → Scenario).

100% bilingual (zh-CN ↔ en). 77% code examples, 76% primary-source quotes, 79% external references.

Static site with per-layer async loading, offline cache, full-text search, 8-layer relationship graph.

item.title: Citation Red Team: 8 P0 fixes shipped (Hunt attribution + arXiv 2601.15494)
item.description:
Fixed 8 high-risk citations before launch:

  • Fowler coinedDate 2025 → 2026-05
  • Simon Willison URL 2025/Mar/16 → 2026/Mar/15
  • arXiv ID 2601.12345 → 2601.15494 (correct paper)
  • Removed unverified Andrew Hunt attribution on cognitive debt
  • Veracode/CodeRabbit phrasing tightened to source language

item.title: 100% English translation milestone · 178/178 terms
item.description: All 178 terms now have English short descriptions and long descriptions. The site is fully bilingual with language toggle (localStorage persistence).

item.title: Round 2: Service Worker offline cache (committed + deployed)
item.description: Site now works offline on repeat visits. Cache-first for static assets, network-first for HTML/data. Repeat visits load in <500ms.

item.title: Round 1: Per-layer async loading (initial JS -85%)
item.description: Replaced 200KB synchronous terms.js with per-layer async loading. Initial page load JS < 30KB. Available across 9 routes.
